title: Technology Sector Update for 12/18/2018: XRX,NXPI,NOK,MRIN,GOOG,GOOGL,DPW
text:

Technology stocks pared some of the prior gains in late trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 still adding more than 0.8% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising almost 1.4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Xerox ( XRX ) tumbled to a six-year low on Tuesday, slipping over 1% to its lowest share price since late 2012 and extending a nearly 13% decline during the prior session that followed Moody's Investors Service cutting its debt rating to Ba1 from Baa3, or one notch below investment grade, citing reduced demand for copying and printing services along with rising global competition for the Dow 30 component stock.
In other sector news:
(+) Marin Software ( MRIN ) surged almost 95% at one point during Tuesday trading after raising its forecast for Q4 revenue by $3 million to a new range of $14.6 million to $15.1 million and slashing its projected non-GAAP net loss by $3 million to between $2.9 million to $2.5 million to reflect the impact of its new, three-year revenue sharing agreement with Google (GOOG,GOOGL).
(+) NXP Semiconductors NV ( NXPI ) recorded a more than 2% gain after the chipmaker, together with cellular telephone specialists Nokia ( NOK ), said it received a CATRENE innovation award from the AENEAS trade group for its work advancing the rollout of 5G mobile communication networks in Europe.
(-) DPW Holdings ( DPW ) was down 16% on Tuesday after the electronic components manufacturer said its board of directors has approved the proposed spinoff of its DPW Technology Group, with the defense and aerospace contractor becoming a stand-alone publicy traded company.
